title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court, the Ministry of Public Security, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, and the State Tobacco Monopoly Administration on Issuing the Summary of the Symposium on the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases of Counterfeit and Shoddy Tobacco Products
keywords_en: criminal cases involving counterfeit and shoddy tobacco products, etc.
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate

Ministry of Public Security, State Tobacco Monopoly Bureau

Notice on Issuing the Summary of the Symposium on the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases Involving Counterfeit and Substandard Tobacco Products and the Like

Gao Jian Hui [2003] No. 4

The high people's courts, people's procuratorates, public security departments (bureaus), and tobacco monopoly bureaus of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Military Procuratorate of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region; the People's Procuratorate of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps; and the Public Security Bureau:

The Summary of the Symposium on the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases Involving Counterfeit and Substandard Tobacco Products and the Like, as formulated by the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, and the State Tobacco Monopoly Bureau, is hereby issued to you for reference in implementation. If any problems arise during implementation, please promptly report them to the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, and the State Tobacco Monopoly Bureau.

December 23, 2003

Summary of the Symposium on the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases Involving Counterfeit and Substandard Tobacco Products and the Like

Criminal acts such as producing and selling counterfeit and substandard tobacco products seriously undermine the national tobacco monopoly system, disrupt the order of the socialist market economy, and infringe upon the legitimate rights and interests of consumers.

Since 2001, the Ministry of Public Security and the State Tobacco Monopoly Bureau have jointly conducted special operations to crack down on counterfeit cigarettes, achieving remarkable results. At the same time, during the investigation and handling of criminal cases involving the production and sale of counterfeit and substandard tobacco products, certain issues regarding the application of law have been encountered. To address these issues, the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, and the State Tobacco Monopoly Bureau held a symposium on the application of law in handling criminal cases involving counterfeit and substandard tobacco products and the like in Kunming from August 4 to 6, 2003. Personnel from the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, the State Tobacco Monopoly Bureau, as well as relevant units including courts, procuratorates, public security departments (bureaus), and tobacco monopoly bureaus from some provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, attended the meeting. The Criminal Law Office of the Legislative Affairs Commission of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress was invited to send representatives to the meeting. On the basis of summarizing case-handling experience and in accordance with the relevant provisions of laws and judicial interpretations, the participants conducted extensive discussions on certain common specific issues concerning the application of law in handling criminal cases involving counterfeit and substandard tobacco products and the like, and reached a consensus. The summary is as follows:

I. Issues concerning the application of law to acts of producing and selling substandard tobacco products

(1) Issues concerning the conviction and sentencing of producing substandard tobacco products that have not yet been sold or have not been fully sold

According to Article 140 of the Criminal Law, producing and selling substandard tobacco products with a sales amount of RMB 50,000 or more constitutes the crime of producing and selling fake and substandard products.

In accordance with the relevant provisions of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues concerning the Specific Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases of Producing and Selling Fake and Substandard Commodities, the "sales amount" refers to all illegal income obtained and to be obtained by the producer or seller after selling the substandard tobacco products. If substandard tobacco products have not yet been sold and the value of the goods reaches three times the sales amount specified in Article 140 of the Criminal Law (i.e., RMB 150,000 or more), the offender shall be convicted and punished for the crime of producing and selling fake and substandard products (attempted). The value of the goods shall be calculated based on the marked price of the illegally produced or sold substandard products; if there is no marked price, it shall be calculated based on the average market price of similar qualified products. If the value of the goods is difficult to determine, it shall be determined by an entrusted appraisal institution in accordance with the Provisions on the Administration of Valuation of Seized, Recovered, and Confiscated Articles jointly issued by the State Planning Commission, the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, and the Ministry of Public Security on April 22, 1997.

If substandard tobacco products have not yet been sold and the value of the goods reaches RMB 150,000 or more but less than RMB 200,000, RMB 200,000 or more but less than RMB 500,000, RMB 500,000 or more but less than RMB 2,000,000, or RMB 2,000,000 or more, the offender shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the corresponding sentencing grades stipulated in Article 140 of the Criminal Law.

If the sales amount of substandard tobacco products is less than RMB 50,000 but the total of the sales amount and the value of the unsold substandard tobacco products reaches RMB 150,000 or more, the offender shall be convicted and punished for the crime of producing and selling fake and substandard products (attempted).

If substandard tobacco products are produced but not yet sold, and the value of the goods cannot be calculated, the offender shall be convicted and punished for the crime of producing and selling fake and substandard products (attempted) under any of the following circumstances:
1. The quantity of substandard tobacco shreds produced is 1,000 kilograms or more;
2. The quantity of substandard tobacco leaves produced is 1,500 kilograms or more.

(2) Issues concerning conviction and punishment for illegally producing, assembling, or selling tobacco-specific machinery

Acts of illegally producing, assembling, or selling tobacco-specific machinery shall be investigated for criminal liability for the crime of producing and selling fake and substandard products in accordance with Article 140 of the Criminal Law.

II. Issues concerning "knowingly" in the act of selling tobacco products that are known to bear counterfeit tobacco trademarks

According to Article 214 of the Criminal Law, selling tobacco products that are known to bear counterfeit tobacco trademarks, if the sales amount is relatively large, constitutes the crime of selling goods bearing counterfeit registered trademarks.

"Knowingly" means knowing or having reason to know. Under any of the following circumstances, it may be deemed as "knowingly":
1. Procuring goods at a price significantly lower than the market price;
2. Selling goods at a price significantly lower than the market price;
3. After being discovered selling tobacco products bearing counterfeit tobacco trademarks, transferring or destroying evidence or providing false certificates or false information;
4. Other circumstances that may be deemed as knowingly.

III. Issues concerning the application of law to acts of illegally dealing in tobacco products

Without permission from the competent tobacco monopoly administrative department, and without a production license, wholesale license, or retail license, producing, wholesaling, or retailing tobacco products, under any of the following circumstances, shall be convicted and punished in accordance with Article 225 of the Criminal Law:
1. The individual's illegal business turnover is RMB 50,000 or more, or the illegal income is RMB 10,000 or more;
2. The unit's illegal business turnover is RMB 500,000 or more, or the illegal income is RMB 100,000 or more;
3. Having previously received two or more administrative penalties for illegally dealing in tobacco products and then illegally dealing again, with an illegal business turnover of RMB 20,000 or more.

IV. Issues concerning accomplices

Anyone who knows or has reason to know that another person is committing the criminal acts specified in Articles 1 to 3 of this Summary, and still commits any of the following acts, shall be deemed an accomplice and investigated for criminal liability according to law:
1. Directly participating in the production or sale of counterfeit and substandard tobacco products, or in the sale of tobacco products bearing counterfeit tobacco trademarks, or directly participating in the illegal dealing in tobacco products, and playing a major role therein;
2. Providing premises, sites, equipment, vehicles, loans, funds, accounts, invoices, certificates, technology, and other facilities and conditions for the purpose of assisting in the production, sale, storage, or transportation of counterfeit and substandard tobacco products, or the illegal dealing in tobacco products;
3. Transporting counterfeit and substandard tobacco products.

If any of the above persons reports another person's crime, which is verified, or provides important clues, demonstrating meritorious service, they may be given a lighter or mitigated punishment; if they have performed major meritorious service, they may be given a mitigated punishment or be exempted from punishment.

V. Issues concerning the punishment of state functionaries who participate in committing the criminal acts specified in Articles 1 to 3 of this Summary

In accordance with the provisions of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues concerning the Specific Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases of Producing and Selling Fake and Substandard Commodities, state functionaries who participate in committing the criminal acts specified in Articles 1 to 3 of this Summary shall be given a heavier punishment.

VI. Issues concerning one crime versus multiple crimes

If the criminal act of the offender simultaneously constitutes the crime of producing and selling fake and substandard products, the crime of selling goods bearing counterfeit registered trademarks, the crime of illegal business operation, or other crimes, the offender shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provision that imposes the heavier punishment.

VII. Issues concerning the conviction and punishment for harboring or transferring illegally produced or sold tobacco products

Anyone who harbors or transfers tobacco products known to be illegally produced or sold shall be convicted and punished for the crime of harboring or transferring stolen goods in accordance with Article 312 of the Criminal Law. Anyone who harbors or transfers illegally produced or sold tobacco products after prior collusion with the offender shall be punished as a joint offender.

VIII. Issues concerning the conviction and punishment for obstructing tobacco monopoly law enforcement personnel in lawfully performing their duties by means of violence or threats

Anyone who obstructs tobacco monopoly law enforcement personnel in lawfully performing their duties by means of violence or threats shall be convicted and punished for the crime of obstructing official business in accordance with Article 277 of the Criminal Law.

IX. Issues concerning the conviction and punishment for inciting the masses to violently resist the implementation of tobacco monopoly laws

Anyone who incites the masses to violently resist the implementation of tobacco monopoly laws shall be convicted and punished for the crime of inciting violent resistance to the implementation of laws in accordance with Article 278 of the Criminal Law.

X. Issues concerning identification

The identification of counterfeit and substandard tobacco products shall be carried out by provincial-level or higher tobacco product quality supervision and inspection institutions authorized by the competent tobacco monopoly administrative department, in accordance with the relevant provisions such as the Administrative Measures for the Identification and Inspection of Counterfeit and Substandard Cigarettes and the Procedures for the Identification and Inspection of Counterfeit and Substandard Cigarettes formulated by the State Tobacco Monopoly Bureau. The identification of counterfeit and substandard tobacco-specific machinery shall be carried out by the national quality supervision department, or the National Tobacco Quality Supervision and Inspection Center entrusted by it, in accordance with the relevant technical standards of the tobacco industry.

XI. Issues concerning the scope of tobacco products and cigarettes

For the purposes of this Summary, "tobacco products" refer to cigarettes, cigars, tobacco shreds, reconstituted tobacco leaves, tobacco leaves, cigarette paper, filter rods, and tobacco tow. For the purposes of this Summary, "cigarettes" include loose cigarettes and finished cigarettes.
